GOOD TO KNOW

GOT A
QUESTION?

How do I enquire about food?

Tap any enquiry button to message DFC on WhatsApp, or call 9101035255. Tell us what you're craving and we'll discuss prices and availability.

Where can I find prices?

Contact DFC for current prices, portion sizes and available combinations. The menu on this website is for browsing.

Can I enquire about a group meal?

Yes. Use “Plan your feast” and share the number of people and your preferred items so we can discuss a suitable combination.

Are vegetarian options available?

The menu includes vegetarian burger and rice bowl options. Please confirm availability, ingredients and preparation arrangements with the team.

What about allergies and dietary needs?

Please speak to the team before ordering about ingredients, allergens and shared preparation areas. Item descriptions are not a complete allergen guide.
